modules.title: Basic Structure of Computers & Machine Instructions
modules.desc: Functional units, operational concepts, bus structures, memory locations, addressing modes, instruction sequencing, and RISC principles.

modules.title: Processor Organization, Datapaths & Pipelining
modules.desc: Single-cycle vs multi-cycle processors, hardwired vs microprogrammed control, 5-stage RISC pipeline, and structural/data/control hazards.

modules.title: Memory Hierarchy, Caches & DRAM Organization
modules.desc: Memory hierarchy, cache organization & mapping (direct, associative, set-associative), replacement policies, write strategies, AMAT optimizations, and DRAM memory systems.

modules.title: Parallel Processing & Multicore Architectures
modules.desc: Flynn's taxonomy (SISD, SIMD, MIMD), shared vs distributed memory multiprocessors, cache coherence, and hardware multithreading.

modules.title: Introduction to Data Structures, Arrays & Stacks
modules.desc: ADT vs CDT, asymptotic notations (Big O, Ω, Θ), sparse matrices, polynomial addition, stack operations, and infix-to-postfix conversion.

modules.title: Linked Lists, Queues & Double-Ended Queues
modules.desc: Singly, doubly and circular linked lists, polynomial addition using lists, linear and circular queue implementations, and deques.

modules.title: Trees, Binary Search Trees & Traversals
modules.desc: Binary trees, array and linked representations, tree traversals (inorder, preorder, postorder), BST insertion/deletion, and AVL basics.

modules.title: Sorting, Searching & Hashing
modules.desc: Selection, insertion, quick, merge, heap, and radix sort; linear and binary search; hash functions and collision resolution.

modules.title: Database Design and Creation
modules.desc: Database approach vs file systems, three-schema architecture, conceptual ER modeling, ER-to-relational mapping, and table creation with SQL DDL constraints.

modules.title: Normalization and SQL Queries
modules.desc: Functional dependencies, normal forms (1NF to 5NF), lossless join decomposition, SQL DDL/DML, joins, aggregates, views, and project milestones.

modules.title: Database Normalization & Functional Dependencies
modules.desc: Functional dependencies, Armstrong's axioms, 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF), and lossless join decomposition.

modules.title: Introduction to NoSQL Concepts & Architecture
modules.desc: Need for NoSQL, CAP theorem, BASE properties, Key-Value stores, document stores, column-family stores, and graph databases.
